package service

import (
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for service_depends_on_gin_abort_or_context_error_response: Services that own transport abort behavior.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type AuthService struct{}

func (s *AuthService) ValidateToken(c *gin.Context) {
	token := c.GetHeader("Authorization")
	if token == "" {
		c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
			"error": "missing authorization header",
		})
		return
	}
	if token != "valid-token" {
		c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusForbidden, gin.H{
			"error": "invalid token",
		})
		return
	}
	c.Status(http.StatusOK)
}

func (s *AuthService) CheckPermission(c *gin.Context, resource string) {
	if resource == "" {
		c.Error(errors.New("resource required"))
		c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{
			"error": "resource parameter is required",
		})
	}
}
